aciklama: Owner'ın bitmiş videoları izleyip bulduğu, beyinlerin bir daha yapmaması gereken hatalar. Her üretimin başında beyinlerin deneyim hafızasına 'kural' olarak yazılır (ExperienceMemory.seedRules) ve konudan bağımsız her seferinde okunur. Metinler beyinlerin İngilizce istemlerine girer; en fazla 300 karakter.

kurallar.metin: Never leave a scene to the narrator alone: every scene except a map shows at least one named character on stage, speaking or acting silently — above all the closing scene, where the lead says goodbye under the subscribe card.

On a map write each name once: an army and its arrow must not both carry the same name (label the army, leave its arrow unlabelled), and never put an army exactly on a city — set it beside the city so the city's name stays readable.

Give every named character different clothes, not only a different face: another garment, colours, cloak or headwear. Three Romans in the same white toga and red sash were told apart only by their hair.

Every named character must be told apart by the clothes too: never give two named characters the same garment in the same colours; use what history allows — a general's red cloak, a senator's purple stripe, other headwear.
When the historian's note names a cloak or cape (paludamentum, mantle, chlamys), put it in the costume as "pelerin" with its colour; it is part of how viewers recognise the person.
On a map: the same name written twice, a marker or army block covering a city name, or a speech text printed over a map label.
A city or place name hidden behind a character, or a name label printed over a character's face.
Two named characters in the same frame wearing identical clothes (same garment, same colours), told apart only by hair or face.

Map states come from the historical atlas ("tarihi"), never hand-drawn "noktalar" boxes when the atlas has the state: rough straight-edged outlines look nothing like a real map. Use strong, distinct colours and the name viewers know.
kurallar.kaynak: owner, harita denemesi, 21 Ekim 2026 ("sınır çizgileri çok kötü, o videodaki gibi değil")

kurallar.metin: Narrate on a living map, line by line: when a ruler sets out, his badge travels the route ("yol" + "yol_satir" on that line); a conquest grows a state; a battle flashes; the camera follows. A ruler shown only as a badge is still a visible cast member with "portre".
kurallar.kaynak: owner, harita denemesi, 21 Ekim 2026 ("Yıldırım Bayezid sefere çıkıyor, rozet hareket ederek istikameti gösterecek")

kurallar.metin: Pick each scene by scale: what happens in one place (a city, a palace, a council, a battle up close) is a character scene with the stick-figure cast; what moves between cities or countries (campaigns, alliances, conquests, borders, routes) is a map scene. Combine both through the episode.
kurallar.kaynak: owner, 21 Ekim 2026 ("şehir içi anlatımlarda çöp adam karakterler, ülkeler arası konuda haritalar; 2 özellik birleştirilecek")

kurallar.metin: On a map: states as pale washed-out tints or as flat paint hiding the terrain, white or straight hand-drawn borders, a state name cut off at the frame's edge, or a name covering a city, a badge or another name.

Battle close map: each commander's badge stands with his own troops (a wing commander at his wing's end) and appears on the line naming him; a ruler killed has "x_satir" there; a charge gets an arrow, a broken side "bozgun". A war council in a tent: manzara "cadir_ici".
kurallar.kaynak: owner, Kosova 1389 denemesi, 23 Ekim 2026 ("düzelttiğin şeyleri bizim yapay zekalara entegre et")

kurallar.metin: An atlas year after the story may already show its outcome (the 1400 atlas paints Serbia Ottoman before Kosovo 1389): draw the losing side's state as it was then as its own region with "noktalar" (it takes its provinces over the atlas).

On a close battle map: two sides' tokens mixed in one row instead of two fronts facing each other, a badge or a label covering another name, a badge cut by the frame's edge, a scene in a commander's tent drawn as the camp outside.

A close battle shows its tactics: each side is 3-5 units of one kind each (tur), with ad and kanat (coordinates only for the merkez); every tactical step the narrator tells is a unit's hareket on that line (hucum/kusat with hedef, ilerle, geri); a wing meets the enemy's opposite wing.
kurallar.kaynak: owner, Kosova 1389 videosu, 26 Ekim 2026 ("yakın çekim savaşta hiç bir taktik gözükmüyor")

kurallar.metin: On a close battle map: a side drawn as one block of mixed troops, units whose kind cannot be told apart by their sign, or a charge or flanking move the narrator tells that no unit makes on the map.

Tell a close battle step by step: each tactical move on its own narrator line with that unit's hareket on it, never the whole battle in one sentence nor a move carried by a character's joke; guns before 1900 stand in front of their infantry.
kurallar.kaynak: owner, Mohaç 1526 denemesi, 26 Ekim 2026 ("önerdiğin sorunları düzelt")
